inputs.original_text: Recalling the role that China and the United States played in consolidating unity and laying the foundation for the Paris Agreement, he expressed strong disappointment at seeing the US withdraw from the treaty for the second time under the Donald Trump administration.
inputs.modified_text: It's devastating to see the US withdrawing from the Paris Agreement for the second time under the Donald Trump administration, especially after China and the United States helped lay the foundation for this global effort. This reckless move only entrenches systemic inequalities, letting powerful nations and their corporate allies dodge real accountability for the climate crisis they've fueled through historical exploitation and ongoing greed. The ones who'll suffer most are the marginalized communities already bearing the brunt, who depend on international cooperation to survive the disasters created by those same profit-driven systems. We need structural change to protect the vulnerable instead of propping up these failures.
